# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def utilization(node: NodeState, cpu: int, mem: int) -> float:
    cpu_fraction = float(cpu) / float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_fraction = float(mem) / float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    return max(cpu_fraction, mem_fraction)

def queue_cost(peak: float) -> float:
    bounded = min(max(peak, 0.0), 0.99)
    pressure = bounded * bounded / max(1.0 - bounded, 0.01)
    excess = max(bounded - 0.60, 0.0)
    return 8.0 * pressure + 160.0 * excess * excess

def modeled_power(node: NodeState, cpu: int, mem: int) -> float:
    if cpu <= 0 and mem <= 0 and node.suspendable:
        return 0.0
    cpu_fraction = float(max(cpu, 0)) / float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    dynamic = max(node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w, 0.0)
    return node.power_idle_w + dynamic * min(cpu_fraction, 1.0)

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    if node.suspended:
        return -1000000.0
    cpu_after = node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request
    mem_after = node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request
    peak = utilization(node, cpu_after, mem_after)
    if peak > 1.0:
        return -1000000.0

    weighted = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    worst = 0.0
    for e in range(len(ctx.graph.src)):
        source = ctx.graph.src[e]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        if source == pod.id:
            other = destination
        elif destination == pod.id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                latency = node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
                if destination == pod.id:
                    latency = ctx.nodes[neighbor.current_node].latency_to_ms[node.id]
                rate = max(ctx.graph.rate[e], 0.0)
                if rate > 0.0:
                    weighted = weighted + rate * latency
                    weight = weight + rate
                    worst = max(worst, latency)

    mean = 0.0
    if weight > 0.0:
        mean = weighted / weight
    before_power = modeled_power(node, node.cpu_allocated, node.mem_allocated)
    after_power = modeled_power(node, cpu_after, mem_after)
    energy_cost = max(after_power - before_power, 0.0) / 40.0
    network_cost = mean / 6.0 + worst / 15.0
    cost = queue_cost(peak) + network_cost + energy_cost
    return -cost

def paths_do_not_worsen(
    pod: Pod,
    source: NodeState,
    target: NodeState,
    state: ClusterState,
    graph: CallGraphCtx
) -> bool:
    for e in range(len(graph.src)):
        other = -1
        outgoing = False
        if graph.src[e] == pod.id:
            other = graph.dst[e]
            outgoing = True
        elif graph.dst[e] == pod.id:
            other = graph.src[e]
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id and graph.rate[e] > 0.0:
            location = state.pods[other].current_node
            if location >= 0:
                old_latency = source.latency_to_ms[location]
                new_latency = target.latency_to_ms[location]
                if not outgoing:
                    old_latency = state.nodes[location].latency_to_ms[source.id]
                    new_latency = state.nodes[location].latency_to_ms[target.id]
                if new_latency > old_latency:
                    return False
    return True

    out: list[Move] = []
    if budget <= 0:
        return out

    # One move keeps each proposal independent and limits disruption per window.
    best_pod = -1
    best_target = -1
    best_gain = 2.0
    for p in range(len(state.pods)):
        pod = state.pods[p]
        eligible = pod.current_node >= 0 and not pod.stateful and not pod.has_pdb
        if eligible:
            source = state.nodes[pod.current_node]
            source_peak = utilization(source, source.cpu_allocated, source.mem_allocated)
            source_cpu_after = source.cpu_allocated - pod.cpu_request
            source_mem_after = source.mem_allocated - pod.mem_request
            source_after_peak = utilization(source, source_cpu_after, source_mem_after)
            source_power_before = modeled_power(source, source.cpu_allocated, source.mem_allocated)
            source_power_after = modeled_power(source, source_cpu_after, source_mem_after)

                target = state.nodes[n]
                eligible_target = n != pod.current_node and not target.suspended
                if eligible_target:
                    target_cpu_after = target.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request
                    target_mem_after = target.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request
                    target_peak = utilization(target, target.cpu_allocated, target.mem_allocated)
                    target_after_peak = utilization(target, target_cpu_after, target_mem_after)
                    safe_load = (
                        source_cpu_after >= 0
                        and source_mem_after >= 0
                        and target_after_peak <= 0.60
                        and target_after_peak <= source_peak
                    )
                    if safe_load:
                        target_power_before = modeled_power(target, target.cpu_allocated, target.mem_allocated)
                        target_power_after = modeled_power(target, target_cpu_after, target_mem_after)
                        gain = source_power_before + target_power_before - source_power_after - target_power_after
                        queue_before = queue_cost(source_peak) + queue_cost(target_peak)
                        queue_after = queue_cost(source_after_peak) + queue_cost(target_after_peak)

                        if worthwhile and paths_do_not_worsen(pod, source, target, state, graph):
                            best_gain = gain
                            best_pod = pod.id
                            best_target = n
    if best_pod >= 0:
        out.append(move_pod(best_pod, best_target))
    return out
